description: Record a follow-up the user sent themselves, for example on LinkedIn or from their own mail app, so the application's follow-up count and next due date stay right. Pass application_id, body (the text they sent, 20 to 4,000 characters), and optionally channel (email, linkedin or other; email by default), recipient and subject. Nothing is sent from GetMattered and nothing is spent. A recorded follow-up cannot be removed with these tools, so record only what the user says they sent. Do not use it to send a follow-up; use getmattered_send_follow_up. Next: getmattered_get_inbox for the employer's answer.

application_id.description: The application, from getmattered_list_due_follow_ups or getmattered_get_applications.

body.description: The text the user sent, 20 to 4,000 characters.

channel.description: Where the user sent it: email, linkedin or other. Defaults to email.

recipient.description: Who it went to: an email address or a LinkedIn handle.

subject.description: The subject line, if the message had one.

name: getmattered_record_follow_up

action.description: The operation that ran: list, history, draft, send or record_sent.

confirmToken.description: From getmattered_send_follow_up when nothing was sent yet: show the user the email, then pass this as confirm_token with the same arguments after their yes. Works once, for 10 minutes.

channel.description: email, linkedin or other: where the message should go.

draft.description: From getmattered_draft_follow_up: the drafted message. Nothing was sent.

applicationId.description: Pass as application_id to getmattered_draft_follow_up, getmattered_send_follow_up or getmattered_record_follow_up.

followUps.description: From getmattered_list_due_follow_ups: applications whose follow-up is due, most urgent first.

history.description: From getmattered_list_sent_follow_ups: follow-ups already sent, newest first.

nextCursor.description: From getmattered_list_sent_follow_ups: pass as cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation and nothing was sent.

recorded.description: From getmattered_send_follow_up or getmattered_record_follow_up: the follow-up count after it was recorded.

title: Record a Follow-up
